annotations.title: EPIC motion scores and first 30 days

description: Helps you decide which go to market motion to lead with and what to do first. You give your main GTM challenge, plus your stage and industry and the optional ACV, deal cycle, NRR, TAM, self serve, deal source and geography for a full score. You get a score from 1 to 10 for each of the four EPIC motions from the documented rubric, the primary and secondary motion and the first 30 days of steps for the primary motion, with sector notes when your inputs name the sector. Without the optional inputs the result is marked preliminary. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of epic_audit when you want EPIC motion scores together with first-30-day actions.

acv_usd.description: Optional. Average contract value per year in US dollars (for example 42000). Format is a JSON number.

business_model.description: Optional. How you charge: software subscription, services, connectivity, per transaction, marketplace, hardware plus software, or investment management. Read from your other inputs when left out. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "saas".

business_stage.description: Stage: pre-seed, seed, series-a, series-b, series-c, bootstrapped (growth counts as Series B). Format is text. For example, "series-a".

company_name.description: Company name. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

current_channels.description: Optional. What you do today (content, outbound, events, partnerships, PLG, community). Format is text. For example, "events and referrals".

deal_cycle_days.description: Optional. Days from first touch to closed-won (for example 120). Format is a JSON number.

deal_source.description: Optional. Where the majority of deals come from. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "referrals".

geography.description: Optional. Primary market. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "india".

gtm_challenge.description: Your GTM challenge. Format is text. For example, "invoice exceptions delay close".

industry.description: Your industry. Format is text. For example, "manufacturing".

nrr_percent.description: Optional. Net revenue retention in percent (for example 108). Format is a JSON number.

self_serve.description: Optional. true if customers can sign up and get value without talking to sales. Format is true or false. For example, true.

tam_accounts.description: Optional. Number of addressable accounts (for example 2500). Format is a JSON number.
